Officer's narrative
Officers respnoded to a low-speed collision in a parking lot in Pearland, Texas. Driver 1 was backing out of a space
when the rear of the vehicle struck the front quarter panel of a vehicle driven by Driver 2, which was stopped in the
adjacent lane. Driver 1 is the named insured on the policy involved. Passenger, riding in Driver 1's vehicle, reported
shoulder pain at the scene and said the impact pushed them against the door frame. Passenger's reported injury is
consistent in type and force with a collision of this kind. The damage to both vehicles lnies up with the described
impact. Scene photographs confirm the geenral point of contact and the final resting positions. Records show no prior
damage to either vehicle. No independent witnesses were located, and the exact seating position of Passenger at the
moment of impact could not be fully determined from statements. Both drivers were cooperative, and the vehicles
were cleared from the lane without further incident. Passenger was transported for evaluation by emergency medical
personnel.
